free_tier.stated: Verbatim: 'Virtual machines for people building things that deserve to exist. Offered freely, without conditions or calendars.' and 'Linux VMs - Full root access. Run containers, host services, build what you need.' The earlier description added 'No invoices... Actually free. We don't want your credit card', 'No expiration' and 'Human review - We read every request'; those exact sentences were not reproduced by the read on 2026-10-22.
